versions.content: ProvidedServiceInstance . localUnicastAddress refer- ence target The ProvidedServiceInstance is allowed to have: • a localUnicastAddress reference to an ApplicationEndpoint that de- fines a UDP Port, • a localUnicastAddress reference to an ApplicationEndpoint that de- fines a TCP Port, • a localUnicastAddress reference to an ApplicationEndpoint that de- fines a UDP Port and a localUnicastAddress reference to an Applicatio- nEndpoint that defines a TCP Port.
